reviews.text: Dr. Ortolani is an old-school veterinarian, but he's knowledgeable and meticulous. He always has a kind word and is dedicated to his work. I called him during his vacation (by mistake, I didn't know), and he still came to the office to check on my dog. Until he retires, he's my trusted vet!
They're wonderful; I've been going to them for over 10 years and will continue to do so. Excellent doctors for all our companions, furry and otherwise!
My first time with him! Excellent impression! He seemed quite knowledgeable!
A "basic" but competent veterinarian with good prices
Very basic, but extremely good. He took meticulous care of my cat.

Very, very superficial, uninformed about breeds. I brought six Sphynx kittens with diarrhea and a cold to the vet. They were sent home with simple vitamins. I returned the next day and was told to wait. On the second day, two of the six died. We rescheduled another appointment for the remaining four, with the doctor's confirmation and reassurance that the antibiotics he would give her would clear up. I found myself waiting at 7:45 PM for the doctor, who never arrived. Once I called, he told me he couldn't come at the moment because he had more important appointments.
I'm speechless.

We had a wonderful time and will continue to bring our cats here. The doctor is very knowledgeable, knows how to treat animals and reassure anxious "parents."
Update (November 2024): The doctor saved our cat by operating on a Sunday and caring for him every day for a week. His endless availability and wonderful professionalism. And he didn't do it for money, because he earned very little. Thank you, Doctor.

Thank you, Doctor. Wonderful person with great empathy and humanity.
Today, Sunday, October 27, 2024, at 2:30 PM, professionalism and availability to the chemist, and your help in times of difficulty and desperation with our kitten Romeo.
The best vet in the area.
Thank you, Doctor.

I will forever be grateful to Dr. Ortolani for extending the life of my almost 17-year-old Jack Russell during his illness. Always available and kind, helping and listening to us in times of need. Thank you, Doctor.
Among the best vets in the neighborhood, scrupulous and professional and with decidedly acceptable rates.
